sehemu: Part II: Consolidated Fund and Finances of the United Republic
jina: Consolidated Fund of the Government of the United Republic
maudhui: (1) All revenues raised or received in various ways for the use of the Government of the United Republic, except revenues of the kind specified in subarticle (2) of this Article, shall be paid into one special fund to be known as the Consolidated Fund of the Government of the United Republic. (2) The revenues which shall not be paid into the Consolidated Fund are those which have been specified by law to be used for a specific purpose or to be paid into another fund for special use.
vifungu: (1) All revenues raised or received in various ways for the use of the Government of the United Republic, except revenues of the kind specified in subarticle (2) of this Article, shall be paid into one special fund to be known as the Consolidated Fund of the Government of the United Republic.
